scope: Actual original PC host execution with original ENG1/ENG3; no complete-game equivalence claim.
observed: Both reach the clear Hercules title menu with START GAME, PASSWORDS and EXIT.
Native Alt+Enter switches requested/current fullscreen bytes to zero; then resize command selects320x240.
Movie service calls are synchronous and returned in longer runs; short timeouts were not proof of indefinite hangs.
Original and replacement process callback identities and boot/menu states correspond in sampled45-second runs.
comparison_limits: Wall-clock snapshots are not aligned to identical animation frames; observed source startup timing differs by approximately0.7seconds.
Correct-windowed screenshot pixel MAE8.83 is diagnostic; animated figures account for much of the difference. Top80rows MAE0.16.
Each run was deliberately terminated at its timeout by the probe; this does not validate natural shutdown.
Interactive navigation, passwords, settings, save/load, reinitialization and engine transitions remain under test.
superseded_diagnoses: The apparent fourth/fifth-frame stall was inside a synchronous movie call; longer runs progressed.
